'''Cera''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of a Republic archaeological salvage team in [[Olaris]], on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Most of her team was lost when [[rakghoul]]s cut them off, and only Cera and her [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] colleague, [[Garthe]], survived. She asked a traveling hero to find her team and see if anyone was still alive. After they returned with the bad news, they also revealed that Garthe and [[Elihsu]] had been stealing. Cera then asked the hero to investigate whether a group of rakghouls were in fact guarding their ancestors.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Cera appears in the mission "The Corpse Counters" in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
